## Unopened Canned Black Beans Shelf Life
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/box-seam.svg

Unopened canned black beans generally have a very long shelf life due to the canning process, which seals food in an airtight environment.

## Typical Storage and Quality
- **Shelf Life**: Canned black beans are typically safe to eat for **2 to 5 years** past their "best by" or "best if used by" date, provided they have been stored properly.
- **"Best By" Date**: This date indicates when the product is expected to be at its peak quality, not necessarily when it becomes unsafe to eat.
- **Quality Decline**: Over time, the texture, flavor, and nutritional value may gradually diminish, but the beans usually remain safe.
- **Signs of Spoilage**: Discard canned beans if the can is:
    - Bulging
    - Leaking
    - Deeply rusted
    - Has a foul odor when opened
    - Shows signs of mold or an unusual texture

## Sources
- **USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service**: https://www.fsis.usda.gov/food-safety/safe-food-handling-and-preparation/food-safety-basics/food-product-dating
